verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests and SDK methods. Each function gets its own URL and runs in its own isolated container. They run in secure isolated runtimes that scale with demand, across 13+ runtimes, and can be deployed from source control or via the CLI. All of this matches the story's serverless HTTP/SDK-invoked functions. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of function deployment and invocation, and documented detail on how function scaling works (a community user reported being unable to find scaling docs for cloud functions).
